'''Eugene Goodilin''' ({{langx|ru|Евгений Алексеевич Гудилин}}; born 18 November 1969) is a Russian chemist and material scientist.

==Biography==
In 2006 was elected in the [[Russian Academy of Science]] and became the youngest corresponding member.<ref>{{cite web | url=http://www.ras.ru/viewnumbereddoc.aspx?id=0f2517cf-b41f-4db6-a5cc-bd69a764ddaf&_Language=en | title=ПОСТАНОВЛЕНИЕ Общего собрания Российской академии наук "Об избрании членов-корреспондентов РАН" | language=ru | publisher=ras.ru | accessdate=15 July 2020 }}</ref>

In 2015, a group of researchers from [[Lomonosov Moscow State University]] under the direction of Goodilin developed a unique method of performing nondestructive analysis of the electron transport chain in living [[mitochondria]], using surface-enhanced [[Raman spectroscopy]].<ref name="physorg">"[https://phys.org/news/2015-11-mitochondria-human-life.html Mitochondria on guard of human life]", Phys.org, 18 November 2015.</ref> Their work in this area was published in the journal ''[[Scientific Reports]]''.<ref name="physorg" />
